systemic_findings: Rank-bearing catalog labels and middle-name expansions need person-level alias normalization.
Compound vehicle-role strings such as TIEfighter must be normalized before lexical scoring.
Special Forces is not sufficient evidence without faction and role; red-stripe pilot markings provide a useful First Order subtype alias.
Color adjectives should be low-weight unless the named entity/species already matches.
Named members of the same species or family, especially Hutts, must remain identity-distinct.
